dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to hear one of your stories, Granny.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Heh heh... The Vanishing Fox, the Tanuki of the Chinju Forest, The Battles of the Onmyouji... These are all timeless tales.

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Eri
dialogues.text: Now then, which one would you like to listen to?
